newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss to go ahead with government bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Swiss to go ahead with government bond auction.

text.p: The Swiss Treasury will stick to its calendar for new issues as planned, and will bring its next Treasury bond as scheduled next week, head of the Swiss Treasury Peter Thomann said.
"We would not be well-advised if we were to delay the new Confederate bond," Thomann said told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"We have had good success with the calendar, and want to be a predictable partner for the market," he added.
Some market participants had speculated that the Treasury would delay its next issue given current market weakness.
But this would run counter to the purpose of the calendar, which was introduced to offset nervousness ahead of new issues.
The Swiss Treasury is due to announce details of its next auction Tuesday at 0700 GMT.
Thomann added that market sentiment can turn, and by the time the bond allocation is announced on March 27, the mood could have turned again.
At the same time, he added that he saw no real reason for a change in the interest rate trend, but added that a correction was to be expected after recent price gains.
